description: Exercise ordinary and bulk role writers against a migrated database as an authorized admin. Verify the managed identity, grants and memberships survive refused writes and ordinary role edits still succeed.
Exercise invitation acceptance, ticket access on an allowed and an excluded board, revocation and conversion through the seat lifecycle. Prove a manual assignment cannot create a seat.
Exercise role inspection, the permissions matrix, a technician profile and manual role pickers with and without the capability. Verify the explanation and read-only controls for an eligible admin.

Exercise upgrade and a second reconciliation with missing and extra grants, a renamed role backed by seat history, an unrelated lookalike and a second tenant. Check exact grants, preserved identities and safe handling of ambiguity.
